name: client-subagent-guidelines
description: Subagent constraints specific to the GnollHack client repository. Covers the three build dependency chains that must not be parallelized across -- makedefs to generated headers to C# interop, des files to levcomp to dlb, and GnollHackX XAML to makedefsdroid to GnollHackM -- and why cross-layer interop work in this repository escalates to the deep tier far more often than elsewhere. Read when writing a plan's Subagent Use section for GnollHack.
